notes:
Account snapshot: ApexSyntax builds IDE-integrated code assistants for enterprise dev teams (VSCode + JetBrains). Very focused on reproducible completions and predictable rollouts. They want model/version pinning so that we can tie a copilot UI to a specific model digest/semver and guarantee reproducibility across releases.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-11-02: inbound MQL, initial qualification (AE: Maya).
- 2025-11-10: discovery call — primary persona: Head of Platform (Andre), wants deterministic code suggestions for CI gating.
- 2026-02-14: security questionnaire sent; customer provided SOC2 scoping notes.
- 2026-02-25: deep-dive with SE (Diego) — demo of streaming completions + pinned-model API; customer requested low-jitter streaming under 50ms tail latency.
- 2026-03-01: demo recording + Fireflies (ff-20260301-apexsyntax-demo).
- 2026-03-05: procurement kickoff, discussed POC scope and contract cadence.

Requirements / constraints (from calls):
- Model pinning: must support pin to exact model artifact (hash or immutable version). Need API to lock/model-map per environment (dev/stage/prod).
- Rollouts: want stepwise rollout: 10% canary -> 30% -> 100% with automated rollback on eval gate failures.
- Eval gates: custom test harness that runs their internal repo snippets + unit-test generation; pass metrics: compilation_rate, test_case_pass_rate, suggestion_precision@k, and downstream CI flakiness metric.
- Reproducibility: deterministic suggestion behavior for same prompt + editor state across sessions; want ability to snapshot KV-cache behavior and seed telemetry.
- Latency: 95th pct token latency target < 60ms for short completions, tail < 150ms for streaming; throughput target 600 concurrent sessions initially.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), KMS for customer-managed keys, audit logs for suggestion content (redacted) for 30 days.
- Deployment: initial POC on Redwood hosted API with VPC peering; long-term evaluating Dedicated or Private for on-prem codebases.

POC plan (agreed verbally):
- Week 0: provide sample pinned-model API + quickstart repo (Diego).
- Week 1: integrate with ApexSyntax IDE plugin, run internal eval harness across 200 repo snippets. Canary routing at 10% for 3 days. Collect eval metrics + perf traces.
- Week 2: extend canary to 30% if eval gates pass; run full regression suite. Provide rollback playbook. Final decision meeting at end of week 2.

Key quotes & notes from contacts:
- "We need to reproduce the exact suggestion that shipped yesterday — debugging relies on that." — Andre (Head of Platform).
- "If the rollout can auto-fail based on our unit-test pass metric, we'll consider Dedicated." — Principal Engineer (Sofia).

Decision factors / buying signals:
- Strong interest in Optimize for automated batching/quant recommendations to reduce token costs.
- Willing to pay for Dedicated if SLA for latency + private KMS available.
- Procurement is sensitive to EDR/attestation and legal data residency for EU customers.

Open actions (owner / ETA):
- SE (Diego): deliver POC quickstart + pinned-model example repo (due 2026-03-11).
- AE (Maya): schedule post-POC decision call for 2026-03-18.
- Security: provide minimal security FAQ + KMS integration notes (link in drive).

Blockers summary: security sign-off and legal data residency review are gating procurement. Need concrete latency numbers on hosted path for 95p token tail before procurement can commit.

CRM shorthand / misc:
- pricing expectation: mid-range enterprise ARR, interested in committed Dedicated if price within $120k-$200k ARR band.
- internal pilot repos: 220 repos, mostly TypeScript + Go.
- integration notes: uses in-house telemetry SDK; will require small SDK adapter for Redwood traces.
- next sync: 2026-03-18 10:00 AM PT (post-POC).
